\[
8x-6y-8k-7=0.

The first equation is the circle centered at \(25+20i\) with radius \(5\). For exactly one complex solution, this line must be tangent to the circle, so the distance from \((25,20)\) to the line equals \(5\):
\[
\frac{|8(25)-6(20)-8k-7|}{\sqrt{8^2+(-6)^2}}=5
\]

\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]
